edits.new: Record exactly one open-ended counterexample question per direction. Name both nodes and describe a concrete potential case to test, rather than merely restating their definitions. Try varying a parent restriction absent from the child's explicit wording while preserving every child requirement. Prioritize applicable identity or consumer restrictions, then further qualifications before shared kind or action. If no restriction is missing, test a shared condition or permitted topic connection. The proposed case is a test, not a claim that admission or exclusion holds. The matching answer must resolve that exact case against the entire child meaning and every parent alternative and permitted topic connection. A failed case does not establish full coverage. Give a valid counterexample if one is found; otherwise establish complete coverage of every child alternative, or use null if admission, exclusion or necessary coverage remains unresolved. The justification must give the decisive basis.
edits.old: Record exactly one open-ended counterexample question per direction. Name both nodes and explicitly test a parent restriction not imposed by the child's wording, if one exists. Prioritize applicable identity or consumer restrictions, then further qualifications rather than shared kind or action. The question may quote or paraphrase one or more conditions. If no restriction is missing, test whether a shared condition or a permitted topic connection admits information outside the parent. In each answer, give a concrete counterexample satisfying the whole child meaning and escaping every parent alternative and permitted topic connection; otherwise establish that every case in every child alternative satisfies all requirements of at least one covering alternative or connection, or use null if admission, exclusion or necessary coverage remains unresolved. The justification must give the decisive admission/exclusion or complete coverage basis.
